===== dev/era/showcase/ui/EraDraw.kt =====
// Generated by ERA. Do not edit: changes are overwritten on the next build.

package dev.era.showcase.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalDensity
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.drawWithContent
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Rect
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.ClipOp
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.ColorFilter
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.ColorMatrix
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Paint
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Path
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.PathOperation
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.addOutline
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.clipPath
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.drawIntoCanvas
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.LinearGradientShader
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.RadialGradientShader
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shader
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.ShaderBrush
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.atan2
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.hypot
import kotlin.math.sin
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.PathEffect
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shape
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.StrokeCap
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawOutline
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.DrawScope
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.translate
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.LayoutDirection

/** CSS `linear-gradient`: the angle (0 = up, 90 = right), or a corner (`to top right`). */
private data class EraLinear(
    val angle: Float?,
    val right: Boolean,
    val bottom: Boolean,
    val colors: List<Color>,
    val stops: List<Float>,
) : ShaderBrush() {
    override fun createShader(size: Size): Shader {
        val deg = angle ?: run {
            // CSS "magic corners": the line is perpendicular to the other diagonal.
            val a = atan2(size.height, size.width) * 180f / PI.toFloat()
            when {
                right && !bottom -> a
                right && bottom -> 180f - a
                !right && bottom -> 180f + a
                else -> 360f - a
            }
        }
        val rad = deg * PI.toFloat() / 180f
        val s = sin(rad)
        val c = cos(rad)
        val half = (abs(size.width * s) + abs(size.height * c)) / 2f
        val cx = size.width / 2f
        val cy = size.height / 2f
        return LinearGradientShader(
            Offset(cx - s * half, cy + c * half),
            Offset(cx + s * half, cy - c * half),
            colors,
            stops,
        )
    }
}

/** CSS `radial-gradient(circle, ...)` from the centre to the farthest corner. */
private data class EraRadial(val colors: List<Color>, val stops: List<Float>) : ShaderBrush() {
    override fun createShader(size: Size): Shader = RadialGradientShader(
        Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height / 2f),
        hypot(size.width / 2f, size.height / 2f).coerceAtLeast(0.01f),
        colors,
        stops,
    )
}

fun eraLinearGradient(angle: Float, colors: List<Color>, stops: List<Float>): Brush =
    EraLinear(angle, false, false, colors, stops)

fun eraCornerGradient(right: Boolean, bottom: Boolean, colors: List<Color>, stops: List<Float>): Brush =
    EraLinear(null, right, bottom, colors, stops)

fun eraRadialGradient(colors: List<Color>, stops: List<Float>): Brush = EraRadial(colors, stops)

/** CSS `text-shadow` (one shadow): offsets and blur in dp. */
@Composable
fun eraTextShadow(x: Dp, y: Dp, blur: Dp, color: Color): androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shadow {
    val d = LocalDensity.current
    return with(d) { androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shadow(color, Offset(x.toPx(), y.toPx()), blur.toPx()) }
}

/** CSS `text-transform: capitalize`: the first letter of every word. */
fun eraCapitalize(s: String): String =
    s.split(" ").joinToString(" ") { w -> w.replaceFirstChar { it.uppercase() } }

/** One CSS `box-shadow` layer. */
data class EraShadow(val x: Dp, val y: Dp, val blur: Dp, val spread: Dp, val color: Color)

/**
 * CSS `box-shadow` (outer): blurred copies of the shape, never drawn under
 * the element itself, as in CSS. The first shadow is on top.
 */
fun Modifier.eraBoxShadow(shadows: List<EraShadow>, shape: Shape): Modifier = drawWithContent {
    val box = Path().apply { addOutline(shape.createOutline(size, layoutDirection, this@drawWithContent)) }
    clipPath(box, ClipOp.Difference) {
        for (s in shadows.asReversed()) {
            val spread = s.spread.toPx()
            val w = size.width + 2f * spread
            val h = size.height + 2f * spread
            if (w <= 0f || h <= 0f) continue
            val outline = shape.createOutline(Size(w, h), layoutDirection, this)
            val paint = Paint().apply { color = s.color }
            eraBlurPaint(paint, s.blur.toPx() / 2f)
            drawIntoCanvas { canvas ->
                canvas.save()
                canvas.translate(s.x.toPx() - spread, s.y.toPx() - spread)
                canvas.drawOutline(outline, paint)
                canvas.restore()
            }
        }
    }
    drawContent()
}

/** CSS `box-shadow: inset ...`: drawn inside the shape, over the background. */
fun Modifier.eraInsetShadow(shadows: List<EraShadow>, shape: Shape): Modifier = drawWithContent {
    val box = Path().apply { addOutline(shape.createOutline(size, layoutDirection, this@drawWithContent)) }
    clipPath(box) {
        for (s in shadows.asReversed()) {
            val spread = s.spread.toPx()
            val blur = s.blur.toPx()
            val hole = Path()
            val w = size.width - 2f * spread
            val h = size.height - 2f * spread
            if (w > 0f && h > 0f) hole.addOutline(shape.createOutline(Size(w, h), layoutDirection, this))
            hole.translate(Offset(s.x.toPx() + spread, s.y.toPx() + spread))
            val m = blur + abs(s.x.toPx()) + abs(s.y.toPx()) + abs(spread) + 1f
            val frame = Path().apply { addRect(Rect(-m, -m, size.width + m, size.height + m)) }
            val ring = Path().apply { op(frame, hole, PathOperation.Difference) }
            val paint = Paint().apply { color = s.color }
            eraBlurPaint(paint, blur / 2f)
            drawIntoCanvas { it.drawPath(ring, paint) }
        }
    }
    drawContent()
}

/** CSS colour filters (`grayscale`, `brightness`, ...) as one 4x5 colour matrix. */
fun Modifier.eraColorFilter(matrix: FloatArray): Modifier = drawWithContent {
    val paint = Paint().apply { colorFilter = ColorFilter.colorMatrix(ColorMatrix(matrix)) }
    drawIntoCanvas { it.saveLayer(Rect(Offset.Zero, size), paint) }
    drawContent()
    drawIntoCanvas { it.restore() }
}

/** CSS `border-style`. */
enum class EraLine { Solid, Dashed, Dotted }

/** One side of a CSS border. */
data class EraSide(val width: Dp, val color: Color, val line: EraLine = EraLine.Solid)

private fun eraStroke(width: Float, line: EraLine): Stroke = when (line) {
    EraLine.Solid -> Stroke(width)
    EraLine.Dashed -> Stroke(width, pathEffect = PathEffect.dashPathEffect(floatArrayOf(width * 3f, width * 3f)))
    EraLine.Dotted -> Stroke(width, cap = StrokeCap.Round, pathEffect = PathEffect.dashPathEffect(floatArrayOf(0.01f, width * 2f)))
}

private fun DrawScope.eraStrokeShape(shape: Shape, color: Color, width: Float, line: EraLine, grow: Float) {
    val inset = width / 2f - grow
    val s = Size(size.width - 2f * inset, size.height - 2f * inset)
    if (s.width <= 0f || s.height <= 0f) return
    translate(inset, inset) {
        drawOutline(shape.createOutline(s, layoutDirection, this), color, style = eraStroke(width, line))
    }
}

/** A border on every side, following the element's shape (`border: 2px dashed red`). */
fun Modifier.eraBorder(width: Dp, color: Color, shape: Shape, line: EraLine): Modifier = drawWithContent {
    drawContent()
    val w = width.toPx()
    if (w > 0f) eraStrokeShape(shape, color, w, line, 0f)
}

/** Different borders per side (`border-bottom: 1px dashed #ccc`). Corners stay square. */
fun Modifier.eraSideBorders(top: EraSide?, end: EraSide?, bottom: EraSide?, start: EraSide?): Modifier = drawWithContent {
    drawContent()
    val rtl = layoutDirection == LayoutDirection.Rtl
    fun edge(side: EraSide?, from: (Float) -> Offset, to: (Float) -> Offset) {
        if (side == null) return
        val w = side.width.toPx()
        if (w <= 0f) return
        val stroke = eraStroke(w, side.line)
        drawLine(side.color, from(w / 2f), to(w / 2f), strokeWidth = w, cap = stroke.cap, pathEffect = stroke.pathEffect)
    }
    edge(top, { Offset(0f, it) }, { Offset(size.width, it) })
    edge(bottom, { Offset(0f, size.height - it) }, { Offset(size.width, size.height - it) })
    edge(if (rtl) end else start, { Offset(it, 0f) }, { Offset(it, size.height) })
    edge(if (rtl) start else end, { Offset(size.width - it, 0f) }, { Offset(size.width - it, size.height) })
}

/** CSS `outline`: drawn outside the element, takes no space. */
fun Modifier.eraOutline(width: Dp, color: Color, shape: Shape, line: EraLine, offset: Dp): Modifier = drawWithContent {
    drawContent()
    val w = width.toPx()
    if (w > 0f) eraStrokeShape(shape, color, w, line, offset.toPx() + w)
}
===== dev/era/showcase/ui/EraRuntime.kt =====
// Generated by ERA. Do not edit: changes are overwritten on the next build.

package dev.era.showcase.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicText
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicTextField
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateListOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.staticCompositionLocalOf
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.DpSize
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle

/** A screen the host can show. */
class EraScreen(val name: String, val title: String?, val content: @Composable () -> Unit)

/** Navigation stack (M6). `go` pushes a screen, `back` pops one. */
object EraNav {
    val stack = mutableStateListOf<String>()
    val current: String? get() = stack.lastOrNull()
    val canGoBack: Boolean get() = stack.size > 1
    fun reset(screen: String) { stack.clear(); stack.add(screen) }
    fun go(screen: String) { stack.add(screen) }
    fun back() { if (stack.size > 1) stack.removeAt(stack.lastIndex) }
}

/** Shows the screen on top of the navigation stack (the start screen at first). */
@Composable
fun EraApp() {
    val name = EraNav.current ?: EraStartScreen
    val screen = EraScreens.firstOrNull { it.name == name } ?: EraScreens.first()
    screen.content()
}

/** The screen's size, for `vw`/`vh` units. Set by each screen. */
val LocalEraScreenSize = staticCompositionLocalOf { DpSize(402.dp, 874.dp) }

/** `50vw`: a share of the screen width. */
@Composable
fun eraVw(percent: Float): Dp = LocalEraScreenSize.current.width * (percent / 100f)

/** `50vh`: a share of the screen height. */
@Composable
fun eraVh(percent: Float): Dp = LocalEraScreenSize.current.height * (percent / 100f)

/** Numbers in text: `3.0` shows as `3`. */
fun eraText(x: Double): String =
    if (x % 1.0 == 0.0 && kotlin.math.abs(x) < 1e15) x.toLong().toString() else x.toString()

/** Text input with a placeholder. Bound to state with `bind`, otherwise it keeps its own text. */
@Composable
fun EraInput(
    placeholder: String,
    style: TextStyle,
    placeholderColor: Color,
    modifier: Modifier,
    value: String? = null,
    onValueChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null,
) {
    var local by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    val text = value ?: local
    BasicTextField(
        value = text,
        onValueChange = { if (onValueChange != null) onValueChange(it) else local = it },
        modifier = modifier,
        textStyle = style,
        singleLine = true,
        decorationBox = { inner ->
            Box {
                if (text.isEmpty()) BasicText(placeholder, style = style.copy(color = placeholderColor))
                inner()
            }
        },
    )
}

===== dev/era/showcase/ui/EraStores.kt =====
// Generated by ERA. Do not edit: changes are overwritten on the next build.

package dev.era.showcase.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import kotlin.reflect.KProperty

class EraSaved<T>(private val key: String, initial: T, decode: (String) -> T?) {
    private val state = mutableStateOf(eraLoad(key)?.let(decode) ?: initial)
    operator fun getValue(thisRef: Any?, property: KProperty<*>): T = state.value
    operator fun setValue(thisRef: Any?, property: KProperty<*>, value: T) {
        state.value = value
        eraSave(key, value.toString())
    }
}

fun eraSavedText(key: String, initial: String) = EraSaved(key, initial) { it }
fun eraSavedNumber(key: String, initial: Double) = EraSaved(key, initial) { it.toDoubleOrNull() }
fun eraSavedBool(key: String, initial: Boolean) = EraSaved(key, initial) { it.toBooleanStrictOrNull() }

/** `store Counter` */
object Counter {
    var count: Double by eraSavedNumber("Counter.count", 0.0)
    var name: String by mutableStateOf("")
    var details: Boolean by mutableStateOf(true)

    fun increment() {
        count += 1.0
    }

    fun reset() {
        count = 0.0
    }

    fun toggleDetails() {
        details = !details
    }
}

package dev.era.showcase.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.CompositionLocalProvider
import androidx.compose.runtime.Immutable
import androidx.compose.runtime.staticCompositionLocalOf
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontFamily
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp

@Immutable
class EraColors(
    val background: Color,
    val border: Color,
    val danger: Color,
    val muted: Color,
    val onPrimary: Color,
    val primary: Color,
    val secondary: Color,
    val success: Color,
    val surface: Color,
    val text: Color,
    val warning: Color,
)

val EraLightColors = EraColors(
    background = Color(0xFFFFFFFF),
    border = Color(0xFFE8E8E8),
    danger = Color(0xFFE5484D),
    muted = Color(0xFF737373),
    onPrimary = Color(0xFFFFFFFF),
    primary = Color(0xFFFF6B35),
    secondary = Color(0xFF2B2D42),
    success = Color(0xFF2E9E5B),
    surface = Color(0xFFF7F7F7),
    text = Color(0xFF171717),
    warning = Color(0xFFF2A93B),
)

/** This skin has no `colors dark`, so dark mode uses the light colors. */
val EraDarkColors: EraColors = EraLightColors

const val EraHasDarkMode: Boolean = false

object EraSpacing {
    val lg = 24.dp
    val md = 16.dp
    val sm = 8.dp
    val xl = 32.dp
    val xs = 4.dp
}

object EraRadius {
    val lg = 22.dp
    val md = 14.dp
    val pill = 999.dp
    val sm = 8.dp
}

object EraBorder {
    val thick = 2.dp
    val thin = 1.dp
}

object EraElevation {
    val lg = 12.dp
    val md = 4.dp
    val sm = 1.dp
}

/** Font: system. */
val EraFont: FontFamily = FontFamily.Default

object EraType {
    val body = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(400), lineHeight = 24.sp)
    val caption = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(500), lineHeight = 18.sp)
    val display = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 40.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(700), lineHeight = 46.sp, letterSpacing = (-0.5).sp)
    val heading = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 28.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(700), lineHeight = 34.sp)
    val title = TextStyle(fontFamily = EraFont, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight(600), lineHeight = 26.sp)
}

val LocalEraColors = staticCompositionLocalOf { EraLightColors }

/** Provides the skin's colors; `dark` selects `colors dark` when the skin has it. */
@Composable
fun EraTheme(dark: Boolean = false, content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalEraColors provides if (dark) EraDarkColors else EraLightColors,
        content = content,
    )
}

/** Screen `Menu` (Menu). */
@Composable
@OptIn(ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)
fun MenuScreen() {
    val c = LocalEraColors.current
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(c.background)) {
        CompositionLocalProvider(LocalEraScreenSize provides DpSize(maxWidth, maxHeight)) {
            // scroll @Menu
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().fillMaxHeight().safeDrawingPadding().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
                // column @Menu/0
                Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(1f).padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 24.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp, Alignment.Top)) {
                    // text @Menu/0/0
                    BasicText("Menu", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.display.copy(color = c.text))
                    // for @Menu/0/1
                    for (p in EraData.Products) {
                        // row @Menu/0/1/0
                        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(1f).eraBoxShadow(listOf(EraShadow(0.dp, 4.dp, 14.dp, 0.dp, Color(0x14000000))), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)).background(Color(0xFFFFFFFF), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)).padding(12.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp, Alignment.Start), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            // image @Menu/0/1/0/0
                            Image(painter = eraImage(p.photo), contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.width(56.dp).height(56.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)), contentScale = ContentScale.Crop)
                            // column @Menu/0/1/0/1
                            Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp, Alignment.Top)) {
                                // text @Menu/0/1/0/1/0
                                BasicText("${p.name}", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.heading.copy(color = c.text))
                                if (p.popular) {
                                    // text @Menu/0/1/0/1/1
                                    BasicText("Popular", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.body.copy(color = c.primary))
                                }
                            }
                            // text @Menu/0/1/0/2
                            BasicText("\$${eraText(p.price)}", modifier = Modifier, style = EraType.body.copy(color = c.secondary))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
